explanation: Combined delivery path: the data-origin layout (src/data/dataOriginLayout.ts) owns pointer keys, build-id rules, generation prefixes, cache policy, purge prefixes and WAF admission, and the query-generation reader (scripts/lib/queryGeneration.mts) is the one pointer-then-manifest read behind prepare:deploy, fetch:query and the uploader, which publishes only WAF-admitted keys. From main, the query index reads its corpus through scripts/lib/queryIndexCorpus.mts, and the uploader's freshness check, the reduced-release macaque check, the deploy verifier and the bundle optimizer parse through the bundle reader. In the merge the uploader's generation prefixes come from the generation reader instead of main's readOptionalJsonp pointer reads. Cloudflare payloads and index bytes are unchanged.
